answer: One defense is hardware-rooted enrollment: each agent registers a key generated inside a secure enclave and posts a bond. The enclave signs a unique attestation, so a sybil operator cannot clone identities without cloning the physical chip; shared roots are detected and slashed. Think of a yarrow: many flower heads, one root—fake accounts betray the same root. The attestation is the kernel from which trust grows, and the bond makes each false identity costly, keeping the market an oasis of honest agents rather than a crowd of copies.
